items.source: @Conditional that checks whether logging export is enabled. It matches if the value of the management.logging.export.enabled property is true or if it is not configured. If the logging exporter name is set, the management.logging.export.<name>.enabled property can be used to control the behavior for the specific logging exporter. In that case, the exporter-specific property takes precedence over the global property.
items.translation: @Conditional 用于检查日志导出是否已启用。如果 management.logging.export.enabled 属性的值为 true 或未配置，则匹配成功。如果设置了 日志导出器名称，可以使用 management.logging.export.<name>.enabled 属性来控制特定日志导出器的行为；在这种情况下，特定于导出器的属性优先于全局属性。

items.source: the name of the logging exporter
